# Ad-hoc call or one-to-one — meeting archetype

## When this lens applies

Apply this lens to a small, loosely structured problem-solving or decision call
that does not fit a more specific meeting type.

## What to extract

Capture the minimum useful context, decisions with rationale, action items,
owners, and follow-ups.

## Missing topics worth noting

Note only missing ownership or next steps that would otherwise make an agreed
action disappear.

## Common interpretation mistakes

Do not inflate an informal exchange into a hierarchy of work items or infer a
team-wide rule from one person's preference.
